descripciones.POP: Heavy caps; the spoken word pops in your color.
descripciones.KARAOKE: The classic: white with an outline and the spoken word in your color.
descripciones.PASTILLA: The spoken word sits inside a pill in your color.
descripciones.BESTIA: Huge letters, thick outline and an offset 3D shadow.
descripciones.MARCA: Hook in two blocks of your colors; the spoken word on your color.
descripciones.EDITORIAL: Magazine lowercase, a stretch in italic serif and captions that light up as they're spoken.
descripciones.ROTULO: Like an interview lower third: a bar in your color, a dark box and the brand name.
descripciones.MINIMO: Left-aligned, no boxes, with a thin line in your color.
descripciones.KEYNOTE: Two-tone hook and words that appear one at a time.
